OpenThe score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.See evidence · L08

Retrospective, not an early warning. Historical analysis of Jun–Aug 2025 only. It does not show live data, raise alarms or detect deposits, rings or coating.

What the evidence shows

How to read this

The score is reference-relativeBand levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.Source: L10

The score is reference-relative

Band levels and abnormal-period membership depend on the Apr-May reference; the plant has not confirmed a normal period.

The score is higher at low feedThe score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.Source: L08

The score is higher at low feed

The score is higher at low feed and during load changes; the Phase 8 load-adjusted analysis is INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

The high band is common, not rareThe HIGH reference-relative band covers about half of August operational buckets; it is not a rare-event flag and not an alarm level.Source: L13

The high band is common, not rare

The HIGH reference-relative band covers about half of August operational buckets; it is not a rare-event flag and not an alarm level.

The O₂ analyser may be reading ambient airFrequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.Neither variant is preferred until the plant explains the Kiln-I!X analyser readingsSource: L07

The O₂ analyser may be reading ambient air

Frequent ambient-air-like kiln-inlet O2 readings; excluding the analyser roughly halves the Jun-Aug score rise and changes the Phase 8 primary result from NOT_SUPPORTED to WEAK. The purge / calibration behaviour needs plant confirmation.

Neither variant is preferred until the plant explains the Kiln-I!X analyser readings
